purpose: Ensure final human confirmation is based on gate overview, blocker summary, four-piece materials, multi-platform checks, and redline scan, not a vague approval.

check_items.standard: Video task id is clearly filled.
Pre-publish final gate overview record is referenced.
Pre-publish blocker summary record is referenced.
Preview, AI label, material authorization, and publishing release all have receipts.
Each platform has a separate check result.
No open redline exists, or it has been returned to manager decision.
Decision is only submit_to_manager_decision, pending_supplement, or rejected.
